# Elysio Experiences

> Booking platform for vacation rentals and local experiences across Latin America and the Caribbean, connecting international tourists with verified local hosts and organizers.

Tourists can search and book verified accommodations (casas particulares, apartments, houses) and local experiences or tours without needing to log in to browse. A $7 USD non-refundable booking fee secures property reservations (no platform fee on experiences); hosts, organizers, and listings are reviewed by an admin team before going live. The remaining balance for stays is paid directly at the accommodation.

## Docs

- [How It Works](https://reservas-app-blue.vercel.app/how-it-works): Step-by-step booking process for tourists and hosts, payment process, and cancellation policy
- [FAQ](https://reservas-app-blue.vercel.app/faq): Common questions about booking, payments, becoming a host, safety, and data privacy
- [API Catalog](https://reservas-app-blue.vercel.app/.well-known/api-catalog): Machine-readable, public read-only endpoints for properties and experiences

## Listings

- [Search Properties](https://reservas-app-blue.vercel.app/search): Browse verified vacation rentals by location, price, guest count, and amenities
- [Experiences](https://reservas-app-blue.vercel.app/experiences): Browse local experiences and tours hosted by verified organizers
- [Sitemap](https://reservas-app-blue.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Full, always-current list of indexable pages, including every individual property and experience listing
